title: Otg Workaround
summary: First of all, the new update and the fact that you can set your adc values for the volume buttons is a masterpiece. Thank you very much for that. I have a clone variant. And I've been trying for a long time to get my otg port to work, partly via reddit posts or github workarounds. Recently I experimented with chatgpt on the dtb. The only success is that according to the kernel log the port is not dead but does not establish a connection. I attached the log (with your dtb version of hg36) in the attachment. Also the tool where chatgpt did to test otg. ![usb_otg_report.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32443175/usb_otg_report.txt) ![otg_check.sh.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32443209/otg_check.sh.txt) My question now is whether you can see from the log what is missing that my otg port could run. Or can fix it via dtb value or it is the hurdle on the kernel side for my device. SSH will not work. Because the otg do nothing on any device i will put on.
